name: Mutual NDA Cover Page
description: Cover page for the Common Paper Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement. Counterparties fill in their specific terms here; it incorporates the standard terms by reference.

name: Mutual NDA
description: Common Paper Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement standard terms, created by a committee of over 40 attorneys representing technology vendors, procurement teams, boutique firms, and Big Law.

name: Cloud Service Agreement (CSA)
description: Common Paper Cloud Service Agreement — a standard agreement for selling and buying cloud software and SaaS products, covering subscription terms, order forms, and standard legal protections.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Common Paper Design Partner Agreement for early-stage product partnerships, allowing a vendor and design partner to collaborate on product development in exchange for access, feedback, and defined usage rights.

name: Service Level Agreement (SLA)
description: Common Paper Service Level Agreement, designed to be used alongside the Cloud Service Agreement (CSA). Defines uptime commitments, measurement methods, and remedies for SLA breaches.

name: Professional Services Agreement (PSA)
description: Common Paper Professional Services Agreement for professional services engagements, covering statements of work, deliverables, payment terms, and IP ownership.

name: Data Processing Agreement (DPA)
description: Common Paper Data Processing Agreement governing how a vendor processes personal data on behalf of a customer, including GDPR and CCPA compliance provisions.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Common Paper Software License Agreement for licensing on-premise or downloadable software, covering license grants, restrictions, support, payment, and standard legal terms.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Common Paper Partnership Agreement for business partnership arrangements, covering roles, revenue sharing, intellectual property, and termination provisions.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Common Paper Pilot Agreement for short-term trials or product evaluations before committing to a longer-term deal, with limited scope and easy termination provisions.

name: Business Associate Agreement (BAA)
description: Common Paper Business Associate Agreement for HIPAA-compliant relationships where a vendor handles protected health information (PHI) on behalf of a covered entity.

name: AI Addendum
description: Common Paper AI Addendum for adding AI-specific terms to existing agreements, covering permitted AI use cases, data handling, output ownership, and liability for AI-generated content.
